Target company: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD). AMD designs computing and graphics processors, including Ryzen, EPYC and Radeon products, serving PC, data-center, gaming and embedded markets.

Focal announcement: AMD Reports First Quarter 2023 Financial Results.

Decision cutoff: 2023-05-02T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: AMD Reports First Quarter 2023 Financial Results. Published date: 2023-05-02. URL: https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1128/amd-reports-first-quarter-2023-financial-results.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: SANTA CLARA, Calif., May 02, 2023 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AMD (NASDAQ:AMD) today announced revenue for the first quarter of 2023 of $5.4 billion, gross margin of 44%, operating loss of $145 million, net loss of $139 million and diluted loss per share of $0.09. On a non-GAAP ( *) basis, gross margin was 50%, operating income was $1.1 billion, net income was $970 million and diluted earnings per share was $0.60. “We executed very well in the first quarter as we delivered better than expected revenue and earnings in a mixed demand environment,” said AMD Chair and CEO Dr. Lisa Su. “Our strategically important Data Center and Embedded segments contributed more than 50 percent of revenue in the first quarter," said AMD EVP, CFO and Treasurer Jean Hu. For the second quarter of 2023, AMD expects revenue to be approximately $5.3 billion, plus or minus $300 million.
